name: Kanban
description:
A board of columns and cards. Cards drag between and within columns with the pointer,
touch (a short press) or the keyboard (Space lifts, arrows move, Space drops), and every
move is announced. A column with a `limit` refuses cards once full and says why; a move the
host rejects flies back. Column headings sit on the canvas above their lanes; cards are
card tiles. Columns collapse to a strip that still takes drops. The board scrolls sideways
and scrolls itself while a card nears its edges; in a narrow container each column fills
the width and a switcher moves between them.
signature: <C extends KanbanCardData = KanbanItem>({ columns, cards: cardsProp, defaultCards, onCardsChange, onCardMove, renderCard, cardLabel, moveMenu, onAddCard, renderAddCard, collapsedColumns, defaultCollapsedColumns, onCollapsedColumnsChange, loading, headingLevel, labels, locale, "aria-label": ariaLabel, className, style, }: KanbanProps<C>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The board's accessible name.

props.name: cardLabel
props.description: The card's name for announcements and its accessible name. Default `card.title`, else its id.

props.name: cards
props.description: The cards (controlled). Order within a column is their order in this list.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: collapsedColumns
props.description: Collapsed column ids (controlled). Collapsed columns still take dropped cards.

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns, in order.

props.name: defaultCards
props.description: The first cards when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultCollapsedColumns
props.description: Collapsed column ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the column titles. Default 3.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ column: (title: string) => string; count: (count: number, limit?: number) => string; countLabel: (count: number, limit?: number) => string; full: (title: string, limit: number) => string; collapse: (title: string) => string; expand: (title: string) => string; addCard: string; addCardTo: (title: string) => string; empty: string; columns: string; previousColumn: string; nextColumn: string; firstColumn: string; lastColumn: string; moveFailed: (title: string) => string; loading: string; moveCard: (label: string) => string; moveToColumn: (title: string) => string; moveUp: string; moveDown: string; movedTo: ({ label, column, position, count }: { label: string; column: string; position: number; count: number; }) => string; moveNotSaved: (label: string) => string; }> | undefined
props.description: Replace any of the wording (see `kanbanMessages`).

props.name: loading
props.description: Cards are loading: each column shows placeholders in the cards' places.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the wording. Default the nearest `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: moveMenu
props.description:
A "Move" menu on each card (columns, and up or down within the column) as an alternative
to dragging, for people who cannot drag (WCAG 2.5.7). It moves the card the way a drop
does: `onCardsChange`, `onCardMove` (with `input: "menu"`), a rejected save puts the card
back, and the move is announced. The button sits in the card's top corner and shows on
hover and focus, and always on touch screens; `KanbanCard` keeps its title and meta clear
of it, so keep the first lines of your own `renderCard` content clear too. Default true;
set false only when the host offers its own way to move cards.

props.name: onAddCard
props.description: Adds an "Add card" button under each column; called with the column's id.

props.name: onCardMove
props.description:
Called after a card moves. Return a promise to save it: the column shows as saving, and a
rejection puts the card back where it was (reject with an Error whose message says why).

props.name: onCardsChange
props.description: Called with the whole list after a move, before `onCardMove` settles. Update `cards` here.

props.name: onCollapsedColumnsChange
props.description: Called with the collapsed column ids when the person collapses or expands one.

props.name: renderAddCard
props.description: Content under each column instead of the "Add card" button: an inline form, a menu.

props.name: renderCard
props.type: ((card: C, state: { dragging: boolean; }) => ReactNode) | undefined
props.description: The card's content inside its tile. Default: `KanbanCard` with `title` and `meta`. Buttons and links inside keep working.

props.name: style
props.description: Layout only.
